subject: Basic question: Where to keep resources?

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Basic question: Where to keep resources?
parts:
Hello,

My code looks like

shinyUI(myLayout( ... ))

where myLayout is defined as

myLayout <- function(headerPanel,middle,mainPanel){
  bootstrapPage(
    tags$head(tags$link(href='http://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Roboto+Slab:700,300',rel='stylesheet',type='text/css')
              ,tags$link(rel="stylesheet", type="text/css",href="./local.css"))
    ,div(class = "container", headerPanel,middle,mainPanel)
    )
}

When i inspect the source (from the webpage), i see the following in the head element

 <link href="http://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Roboto+Slab:700,300" rel="stylesheet" type="text/css"/>
 <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="./local.css"/>


But clicking on local.css tells me it cant be found. So where do i place css ,images etc ?

Thank you for a great app.
Cheers
Saptarshi

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Basic question: Where to keep resources?
parts: Put them in a "www" subdirectory of your application dir; anything there will be exposed at the root level (i.e. don't add "./www" to the URL).
